row.reason: Butler National is mainly an aerospace business (aircraft modifications, avionics, defense electronics) with a casino management segment. Accel Entertainment matches only the gaming segment, and even there it differs: Accel places and operates video gaming terminals in third-party bars and truck stops, while Butler manages Boot Hill Casino. Because Accel matches only one of Butler's material businesses, the grade is capped at 1.
